name: Scroll Image Fly-Through
description: A GSAP ScrollTrigger image animation for React: in a pinned section, photos appear one after another in the centre with an elastic pop, then sink back into 3D depth with a random tilt and sweep up out of the frame, so the stack streams away as you scroll. Scrubbed by scroll, CSS 3D only.

props.name: images
props.description: Image URLs, shown in order (each fits a square, contained).

props.name: length
props.description: Section height in screens: more is a slower flight.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Largest random tilt as an image flies away, in degrees either way.

props.name: overlap
props.description: Gap between images, as a share of one image's flight (lower = denser stream).

props.name: pop
props.description: Pop each image in from 90% with an elastic bounce.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.
